About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

We're looking for a seasoned Senior PR Manager to own Perk's US and UK media presence. This is a high-impact role at the heart of one of our most important strategic priorities: establishing Perk as a leading voice in major business and financial press.

Both markets are fast-growing for Perk, and cutting through in either requires deep journalist relationships, a sharp corporate narrative, and someone who can work at the pace of a major news cycle. You'll be the on-the-ground force behind our Tier 1 media strategy, shaping how our executives show up in the press and building the kind of earned presence no paid campaign can replicate.

This is a role for a natural communicator who understands the nuance of financial and business media, can translate complex tech and AI narratives into compelling stories, and knows how to get a C-suite executive ready for a Bloomberg interview on short notice.


What you'll do

Own the US and UK media strategy: Lead Perk's day-to-day PR activity from proactive pitching and newsjacking to reactive press office and crisis communications. You'll be the primary point of contact for US and UK journalists and the go-to expert on those media landscapes internally.

Build and deepen Tier 1 relationships: Cultivate and maintain genuine relationships with journalists at WSJ, Bloomberg, the FT, CNBC, Forbes and beyond — not just for coverage, but for the kind of background briefings and exclusives that build long-term credibility.

Shape the corporate narrative: Work with senior leadership to develop and maintain Perk's corporate narrative, ensuring our messaging on company growth, financial performance, AI innovation and platform positioning is consistent, compelling and landing with the right audiences.

Drive executive profiling: Partner closely with our C-suite to build their media profiles — crafting commentary, preparing spokespeople for interviews, and developing a proactive profiling strategy that puts our executives in front of the journalists and audiences that matter most.

Translate tech and AI narrative: Work with product and engineering teams to turn Perk's AI and technology innovation into media-ready stories — making complex product developments accessible, relevant and newsworthy for mainstream business press.

Manage PR agency relationships: Brief, manage and hold our US and UK PR agencies accountable to clear KPIs — bringing the rigour and direction needed to get the most out of the partnership while building in-house capability alongside it.

Bring AI into the workflow: Bring AI tools into day-to-day PR operations, from media monitoring and drafting to research and reporting, to make the function faster and sharper without losing judgement or voice.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • Extensive experience in PR or corporate communications with a clear focus on the US and UK market

  • Deep, existing relationships with Tier 1 US and UK financial and business press and proven track record securing earned coverage (digital and broadcast)

  • Financial communications background — experienced handling funding rounds, M&A and business performance narratives

  • Experience building compelling corporate narratives — able to take complex positioning and turn it into a differentiated story that lands with business press

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leadership teams to craft commentary and prepare C-suite spokespeople

  • Strong agency management background — comfortable briefing, managing and holding agencies to account

  • Strong background in B2B technology, fintech or SaaS essential

Skills

  • Sharp editorial judgement — knows what makes a story

  • Strong writer — press releases, bylines, executive commentary and media briefings all to a high standard

  • Confident media trainer and spokesperson coach for C-suite executives

  • Comfortable working with data (survey results, product analytics, market research) and shaping it into a clear, pitchable narrative

  • Commercially minded — understands how PR contributes to pipeline, brand salience and competitive positioning

  • Comfortable building AI into day-to-day PR workflows (drafting, research, monitoring, reporting) to work faster without sacrificing judgement or quality.

Ways of working

  • Self-starter who can own a US and UK PR programme independently and support the Director of Communications on corporate and financial priorities, while collaborating closely with a global team

  • Comfortable working across time zones and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously

  • Data-driven — uses coverage data, share of voice and inbound metrics to inform strategy and demonstrate ROI

  • Thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly

  • Intellectually curious — reads widely, spots trends early and brings proactive story ideas to the table unprompted

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Siteimprove is a global leader in digital accessibility, content optimization, and web governance, empowering organizations to deliver inclusive, high-performing digital experiences. With the launch of Siteimprove.ai, the only enterprise platform that unifies content compliance and content performance, we are leading the way in the AI era, helping organizations ensure content performs for both humans and AI. From accessibility to SEO, analytics, and content strategy, our platform enables organizations to optimize content that is both compliant and discoverable.

As a Field Marketing Manager at Siteimprove, you will lead the strategy and execution of high-impact field marketing initiatives that drive demand generation, pipeline acceleration, and brand growth across international markets, with a primary focus on our EU markets. This role owns regional field marketing strategy and associated pipeline targets, translating global priorities into locally relevant, scalable programs that directly support revenue objectives. 

You are an experienced strategic partner to regional sales leadership, responsible for shaping integrated inbound and outbound marketing programs, influencing go-to-market plans, and optimizing investment based on performance insights. With a deep understanding of regional market dynamics and buyer behavior, you will proactively identify growth opportunities, guide program prioritization, and continuously refine field marketing approaches through data-driven analysis. This role also serves as a key connector between global marketing, sales, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, consistency, and measurable business impact.


What you will be doing
  • Strategic Planning and Execution: 
    Own the regional field marketing strategy, developing and executing integrated, multi-channel plans that align with global priorities while addressing regional market dynamics to drive sustained demand generation, pipeline growth, and brand impact to meet regional pipe goals. 

  • Event Strategy and Management: 
    Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of high-impact regional and multi-market events—including conferences, trade shows, executive programs, webinars, and roadshows—ensuring clear objectives, strong sales alignment, and measurable contribution to pipeline and revenue. 

  • Campaign Localization and Optimization: 
    Serve as the regional expert in adapting and scaling global campaigns, ensuring they are localized effectively to meet market needs, resonate with target audiences, and deliver consistent brand messaging while maximizing performance. 

  • Demand Generation and Funnel Ownership: 
    Design, execute, and optimize comprehensive demand generation and lead nurturing programs across the full buyer journey, partnering with sales to influence pipeline velocity, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes. 

  • Sales Partnership and Stakeholder Leadership: 
    Act as a strategic partner to regional sales leadership, collaborating on go-to-market planning, account-based initiatives, and territory priorities to improve lead quality, sales enablement, and overall marketing impact. 

  • Performance Measurement and Data-Driven Decision Making: 
    Define success metrics, analyze performance data, and leverage market insights to continuously optimize programs, inform investment decisions, and clearly communicate results and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 

  • Integrated Multi-Channel Campaign Leadership: 
    Lead the development and execution of integrated campaigns across email, digital advertising, social, and other channels, ensuring cohesive execution, consistent messaging, and alignment from strategy through delivery. 

  • Brand Leadership and Regional Positioning: 
    Champion brand consistency and positioning across assigned regions, ensuring a strong, differentiated, and locally relevant brand presence across all field marketing initiatives. 

  • Budget Ownership and Resource Allocation: 
    Own and manage regional field marketing budgets, making strategic investment decisions to maximize ROI, scale high-performing initiatives, and balance short-term impact with long-term growth. 

  • Marketing Technology and Enablement: 
    Leverage and optimize marketing technology platforms—including Pardot, HubSpot, 6sense, and CRM systems—to improve campaign execution, targeting, measurement, and reporting, while driving best practices across the region. 

  • Additional Leadership Contributions: 
    Contribute to broader field marketing initiatives, mentor junior team members as needed, and support cross-functional projects that advance regional and global marketing objectives.

    • What we will require of you
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in field marketing or demand generation roles, with demonstrated success driving pipeline and revenue impact within enterprise IT and/or B2B SaaS environments across one or more European regions; namely UKI, Nordics or Benelux. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience delivering complex, multi-market marketing programs.
  • Advanced proficiency in marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., Pardot, HubSpot, Salesforce), with experience leveraging these tools to support segmentation, attribution, reporting, and optimization at scale.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with a proven track record of using data, insights, and performance metrics to inform decision-making, prioritize investments, and optimize field marketing outcomes.
  • Extensive experience planning and executing integrated field marketing programs, including high-impact regional events, webinars, digital campaigns, and account-based initiatives, with clear contribution to pipeline performance.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing channels, including paid and organic tactics, and how they integrate with field and sales-led motions across the buyer journey.
  • Excellent program and project management capabilities, with the ability to lead multiple complex initiatives simultaneously, manage dependencies, and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and serve as a trusted partner to sales and marketing leadership.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Siteimprove is a global leader in digital accessibility, content optimization, and web governance, empowering organizations to deliver inclusive, high-performing digital experiences. With the launch of Siteimprove.ai, the only enterprise platform unifying content compliance and content performance, we are leading the way in the AI era—where content must perform for both humans and AI.

From accessibility and SEO/AIO to analytics and content intelligence, our Agentic Content Intelligence Platform enables organizations to create, govern, and optimize digital content that is compliant, discoverable, and effective at scale.

We are seeking a high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA Enterprise Sales team. In this quota-carrying role, you will drive new business growth across strategic enterprise accounts, partnering with organizations typically ranging from 250M–5B+ in revenue.

You will engage senior stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, Communications, IT, Accessibility, and Procurement to uncover business challenges and deliver measurable outcomes through Siteimprove’s SaaS and AI-powered platform. This is a full-cycle sales role where you will lead everything from prospecting and discovery through to solution alignment, negotiation, and close.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply—even if they don’t meet every requirement. If you are motivated by impact, growth, and working at the intersection of AI, content, and digital experience, we want to hear from you.


What you will be doing
  • Own the full sales cycle for named enterprise accounts, driving both new logo acquisition and expansion opportunities within your territory
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across Marketing, Digital, Communications, IT, Accessibility, and Procurement
  • Execute a multi-threaded sales approach to navigate complex enterprise buying processes and long sales cycles
  • Identify customer challenges and align Siteimprove’s accessibility, analytics, SEO, and content intelligence solutions to business outcomes
  • Partner closely with internal teams including Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Value Consulting, and Customer Success to deliver tailored, high-impact customer engagements
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management in Salesforce, ensuring disciplined opportunity progression
  • Stay informed on EU digital accessibility regulations, AI governance trends, and enterprise compliance requirements
  • Represent Siteimprove at industry events, conferences, and regional customer forums across EMEA
  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing across the sales organization

    If business needs change and the role is expanded to include access to FedRAMP-authorized systems or data, any required verification, authorization, confidentiality, or access-control requirements must be successfully completed before such access is granted. 


    What we will require of you
    • 7+ years of SaaS sales experience with a strong track record in new business and/or account growth
    • Experience selling Martech, digital experience, or related enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Oracle, Demandbase, Amplitude, Braze, 6sense)
    • Fluency in German (written and spoken), with experience selling into the DACH market strongly preferred
    • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
    • Experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders (CMO, CDO, CIO, and equivalent roles)
    • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to build, forecast, and close large, strategic deals
    • Collaborative mindset with a strong bias for action, learning, and cross-functional partnership
    • High resilience, adaptability, and performance orientation in a fast-paced environment

    What we will love about you
  • Experience selling into regulated or highly governed industries such as financial services, insurance, or public sector
  • Passion for digital accessibility, inclusive design, ESG, or responsible AI
  • Familiarity with value-based selling methodologies (MEDDICC or similar) and consultative enterprise sales approaches

    • What you'll love about us
    We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

    In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

    At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our UK benefits are designed to help you stay healthy, maintain a healthy work-life balance, and plan confidently for the future.

    Rest and relaxation: 25 days of annual holiday, plus support for flexible and sustainable commuting to our London office.

    Comprehensive benefits: Private medical coverage through Bupa, wellbeing and employee support services through Canada Life, and a weekly lunch allowance.

    Prepare for the future: Company pension benefits through Aviva to help support your long-term financial goals.

Please note that personal information may be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in accordance with our Privacy Policy at https://siteimprove.com/en/privacy/.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Consultant – Palo Alto Networks (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Nomios Germany befindet sich in einer spannenden Aufbauphase. Als Unternehmen der internationalen Nomios Group gestalten wir zukunftssichere Cybersecurity- und Netzwerklösungen aus einer Hand – von der strategischen Beratung und dem Setup über die Implementierung bis hin zum nachhaltigen Betrieb und kontinuierlichen Support. Mit Präsenz in 10 Ländern und mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeitenden vereint die Nomios Group internationale Stärke mit lokaler Expertise. Mit aktuell 34 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland suchen wir einen erfahrenen Cybersecurity Consultant mit Schwerpunkt auf dem Palo-Alto-Networks-Portfolio zur Verstärkung unseres Consulting-Teams.

 

Das erwartet Dich:
In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du Kundenprojekte eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Du bist dabei nicht nur technischer Experte, sondern auch das Gesicht von Nomios beim Kunden – Du führst Präsentationen und Workshops selbstständig durch und überzeugst durch fundiertes Fachwissen und sicheres Auftreten.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Eigenständige Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten rund um das Palo-Alto-Networks-Portfolio, von der Konzeption bis zum Go-Live

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Sicherheitsarchitekturen auf Basis von Next-Generation Firewalls, Panorama-Management, Prisma Access (SASE), Prisma Cloud sowie Cortex XDR

  • Analyse und Bewertung von Kundenanforderungen sowie Entwicklung passgenauer, auf das Palo-Alto-Portfolio zugeschnittener Lösungen

  • Durchführung von technischen Präsentationen, Workshops und Lösungsvorstellungen direkt beim Kunden, auf Fach- und Managementebene

  • Erstellung von High-Level- und Detail-Architekturen (HLD/LLD) sowie technischer Dokumentation

  • Planung und Durchführung von Proof-of-Concepts, Installationen und Konfigurationen in Kundenumgebungen

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Vertrieb und internen Fachteams entlang des gesamten Projektzyklus, von der Angebotsphase bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Zertifizierung im Palo-Alto-Umfeld, um stets aktuelles Herstellerwissen einzubringen

  • Mehrjährige, nachweisbare Berufserfahrung als Security-Spezialist mit Schwerpunkt Palo Alto Networks

  • Fortinet- und/oder CrowdStrike-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Leitung von Consulting- oder Kundenprojekten, ohne engmaschige Anleitung

  • Sicheres, überzeugendes Auftreten sowie ausgeprägte Präsentations- und Kommunikationsstärke im direkten Kundenkontakt

  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Next-Generation Firewalls, SASE/Zero-Trust-Architekturen sowie Cloud- und Endpoint-Security

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Eigeninitiative

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Bevorzugte Zertifizierung:

  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)

  • Palo Alto Networks Certified Cloud Security Engineer (PCCSE)

  • Fortinet NSE (Network Security Expert), z. B. NSE 4–7

  • CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator / Responder (CCFA / CCFR)

  • Vergleichbare herstellerspezifische Zertifizierungen im Security-Umfeld

Das erwartet Dich:

  • Spannende, abwechslungsreiche Projekte in einem der zukunftsträchtigsten IT-Felder der Gegenwart

  • Die Möglichkeit, unser wachsendes Consulting-Team aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Ein motiviertes, kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

  • Raum für persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung

jobs.description:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

As our Engineering Team Lead (f/m/d), you combine strong people leadership with hands-on technical expertise to guide and grow a high-performing team. Your team owns its domain and sits at the heart of Zeal's B2B core platform: its customers are the core platform teams themselves, whom you enable with reliable, scalable shared services.

Your tasks:

  • You lead a platform-focused engineering team responsible for building reliable, scalable shared services that enable all product teams

  • Hire, Build and lead a team of 2 engineers: Hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team, fostering an ownership-driven and reliability-focused engineering culture

  • Lead technically and strategically, define and drive architectural decisions together with your team

  • Code as part of the team: While guiding architecture and strategy, you’ll regularly write code, contribute to features, and help solve complex technical challenges together with your team

  • Champion the effective use of AI in your team's engineering workflows (e.g. AI-assisted development and tooling) and explore opportunities to apply AI within the platform's capabilities

  • Establish and drive reliability practices: Design and implement monkey testing and load testing strategies to proactively identify weaknesses and continuously improve platform resilience and stability

  • Own prioritization and backlog: Balance reliability, tech debt, operational, and business demands with stakeholders across Core, Product, and Platform, keeping a transparent roadmap focused on the highest-value work.

  • Own core technical services: Take end-to-end ownership of internally developed platform services such as Auth Service, API Gateway, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and easy to consume

  • Act as the bridge between domains: Collaborate closely with Core domain teams and the Platform team to understand needs, identify gaps, and provide efficient, reusable technical solutions

  • Enable data and event flows: Own and evolve solutions core technical tracking infrastructure, ensuring reliable and scalable event collection and forwarding to downstream systems

  • Deliver secure, robust and maintainable technical solutions while focusing on great customer experiences and business needs

What you offer us:

  • Proven people leadership skills with the ability to grow teams from early stage to high performance

  • Strong hands-on engineering background in Kotlin/Spring Boot, Mongo/PostgresDB ideally paired with DevOps experience

  • Experience designing and operating reliable, scalable distributed systems, including resilience patterns and failure handling

  • Strong understanding of observability, monitoring, and performance testing including load/monkey testing

  • Experience building and evolving internal platform services and APIs that are easy for other teams to consume

  • “You build it, you run it” mindset with hands-on experience running services in Kubernetes-based environments

  • Ability to balance standardization vs. team autonomy

  • Strong collaboration and alignment skills across multiple engineering teams and stakeholders from other deparments

  • Pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset with a focus on enabling others and reducing complexity

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in building secure, scalable, and reliable systems, including security-by-design, resilience patterns, and operating production systems at scale.

What we offer:

  • State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/)

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

  • Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

  • Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

  • Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program.

  • Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security.

  • Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.

  • Monthly company events, team activities, and informal gatherings, including our popular company-wide lunches provided four days a week.
